Aggregates a raster to a coarser one, of cells of factor x factor input cells.

**Toolbox folder:** Raster Processing<br>
**Status:** Certified<br>
**Keywords:** Raster, Subsampling, Aggregation, Resolution<br>
**Authors:** Andrea Antonello<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.modules.RasterSubsampler`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inRaster` | raster file |  |  | The raster to aggregate. |
| `pFactor` | int |  | `2` | The number of input cells per side of an output cell (default is 2). |
| `pMode` | String |  | `avg` | The aggregation of the cells of a block (default is avg). Allowed values: `avg`, `min`, `max`, `sum`, `majority`, `nearest`. |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outRaster` | output file |  | The aggregated raster. |
